title: Quick Study
summary: Tool: Quick Study Prompt to Claude Opus 5.5 High : Build an artifact where you open a photo and it rapidly (in a few seconds) paints a version of that photo using a canvas element and simulated paintbrush See also my previous experiment getting Claude Fable to simulate a watercolor illustration with P5.js. Quick Study uses Sobel edge detection , with no external libraries beyond Google Fonts. Tags: tools
body:
Prompt to Claude Opus 5.5 High :

Build an artifact where you open a photo and it rapidly (in a few seconds) paints a version of that photo using a canvas element and simulated paintbrush

See also my previous experiment getting Claude Fable to simulate a watercolor illustration with P5.js.

Quick Study uses Sobel edge detection , with no external libraries beyond Google Fonts.

images.alt: A simulated oil painting of a photograph of a heron

summaryZh: 构建一个工件，您打开一张照片，它就会使用画布元素和模拟画笔快速（几秒钟）绘制该照片的一个版本。另请参阅我之前的实验，让 Claude Fable 使用 P5.js 模拟水彩插图。 Quick Study 使用 Sobel 边缘检测，除了 Google Fonts 之外没有任何外部库。
